from ortools.sat.python import cp_model
import json

def main():
    stations = list(range(20))
    start = 0
    end = 19
    path_length = 6
    max_energy = 80
    max_time = 45
    
    station_energy = [0, 3, 2, 4, 1, 3, 2, 5, 2, 1, 4, 3, 2, 3, 1, 4, 2, 3, 2, 0]
    station_time = [0, 2, 3, 1, 2, 2, 4, 1, 3, 2, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 1, 0]
    
    transit_exists = [[0 for _ in range(20)] for _ in range(20)]
    transit_cost = [[0 for _ in range(20)] for _ in range(20)]
    transit_energy = [[0 for _ in range(20)] for _ in range(20)]
    transit_time = [[0 for _ in range(20)] for _ in range(20)]
    
    transit_data = [
        (0, 1, 12, 4, 3),
        (0, 2, 18, 3, 4),
        (0, 3, 25, 5, 2),
        (1, 4, 15, 3, 3),
        (1, 5, 22, 4, 2),
        (1, 6, 20, 3, 4),
        (2, 4, 10, 2, 4),
        (2, 7, 16, 3, 3),
        (2, 8, 24, 5, 2),
        (3, 5, 14, 3, 2),
        (3, 9, 18, 4, 3),
        (3, 10, 26, 6, 2),
        (4, 6, 14, 4, 3),
        (4, 9, 18, 4, 3),
        (5, 11, 18, 4, 3),
        (5, 12, 22, 5, 2),
        (6, 11, 16, 3, 4),
        (6, 13, 20, 4, 3),
        (7, 12, 14, 3, 3),
        (7, 14, 20, 4, 3),
        (8, 13, 14, 3, 3),
        (8, 15, 18, 4, 3),
        (9, 14, 16, 3, 3),
        (9, 16, 22, 5, 2),
        (10, 15, 16, 3, 3),
        (10, 17, 22, 5, 2),
        (11, 16, 14, 3, 4),
        (11, 17, 18, 4, 3),
        (11, 18, 24, 5, 2),
        (12, 17, 12, 2, 4),
        (12, 19, 28, 6, 3),
        (13, 18, 16, 3, 3),
        (13, 19, 22, 5, 2),
        (14, 17, 10, 2, 3),
        (14, 18, 18, 4, 2),
        (15, 18, 14, 3, 4),
        (15, 19, 20, 4, 3),
        (16, 18, 12, 2, 3),
        (16, 19, 18, 4, 2),
        (17, 19, 16, 3, 4),
        (18, 19, 12, 2, 3)
    ]
    
    for i, j, cost, energy, time in transit_data:
        transit_exists[i][j] = 1
        transit_cost[i][j] = cost
        transit_energy[i][j] = energy
        transit_time[i][j] = time
    
    model = cp_model.CpModel()
    
    x = {}
    for i in stations:
        for j in stations:
            if transit_exists[i][j] == 1:
                x[i, j] = model.NewBoolVar(f"x[{i},{j}]")
    
    y = {}
    for i in stations:
        y[i] = model.NewBoolVar(f"y[{i}]")
    
    position = []
    for k in range(path_length):
        position.append(model.NewIntVar(0, 19, f"position[{k}]"))
    
    all_edges = []
    for i in stations:
        for j in stations:
            if transit_exists[i][j] == 1:
                all_edges.append(x[i, j])
    model.Add(sum(all_edges) == path_length - 1)
    
    visited_stations = []
    for i in stations:
        visited_stations.append(y[i])
    model.Add(sum(visited_stations) == path_length)
    
    model.Add(position[0] == start)
    
    model.Add(position[path_length - 1] == end)
    
    model.AddAllDifferent(position)
    
    for k in range(path_length - 1):
        allowed_pairs = []
        for i in stations:
            for j in stations:
                if transit_exists[i][j] == 1:
                    allowed_pairs.append((i, j))
        
        model.AddAllowedAssignments([position[k], position[k + 1]], allowed_pairs)
    
    for i in stations:
        for j in stations:
            if transit_exists[i][j] == 1:
                indicators = []
                for k in range(path_length - 1):
                    indicator = model.NewBoolVar(f"ind_{k}_{i}_{j}")
                    pos_k_eq_i = model.NewBoolVar(f"pos{k}_eq_{i}")
                    pos_k1_eq_j = model.NewBoolVar(f"pos{k+1}_eq_{j}")
                    
                    model.Add(position[k] == i).OnlyEnforceIf(pos_k_eq_i)
                    model.Add(position[k] != i).OnlyEnforceIf(pos_k_eq_i.Not())
                    
                    model.Add(position[k + 1] == j).OnlyEnforceIf(pos_k1_eq_j)
                    model.Add(position[k + 1] != j).OnlyEnforceIf(pos_k1_eq_j.Not())
                    
                    model.AddBoolAnd([pos_k_eq_i, pos_k1_eq_j]).OnlyEnforceIf(indicator)
                    model.AddBoolOr([pos_k_eq_i.Not(), pos_k1_eq_j.Not()]).OnlyEnforceIf(indicator.Not())
                    
                    indicators.append(indicator)
                
                model.AddBoolOr(indicators).OnlyEnforceIf(x[i, j])
                model.AddBoolAnd([ind.Not() for ind in indicators]).OnlyEnforceIf(x[i, j].Not())
    
    for i in stations:
        indicators = []
        for k in range(path_length):
            indicator = model.NewBoolVar(f"visit_ind_{k}_{i}")
            model.Add(position[k] == i).OnlyEnforceIf(indicator)
            model.Add(position[k] != i).OnlyEnforceIf(indicator.Not())
            indicators.append(indicator)
        
        model.AddBoolOr(indicators).OnlyEnforceIf(y[i])
        model.AddBoolAnd([ind.Not() for ind in indicators]).OnlyEnforceIf(y[i].Not())
    
    energy_terms = []
    for i in stations:
        energy_terms.append(y[i] * station_energy[i])
    for i in stations:
        for j in stations:
            if transit_exists[i][j] == 1:
                energy_terms.append(x[i, j] * transit_energy[i][j])
    
    total_energy = model.NewIntVar(0, max_energy * 10, "total_energy")
    model.Add(total_energy == sum(energy_terms))
    model.Add(total_energy <= max_energy)
    
    time_terms = []
    for i in stations:
        time_terms.append(y[i] * station_time[i])
    for i in stations:
        for j in stations:
            if transit_exists[i][j] == 1:
                time_terms.append(x[i, j] * transit_time[i][j])
    
    total_time = model.NewIntVar(0, max_time * 10, "total_time")
    model.Add(total_time == sum(time_terms))
    model.Add(total_time <= max_time)
    
    cost_terms = []
    for i in stations:
        for j in stations:
            if transit_exists[i][j] == 1:
                cost_terms.append(x[i, j] * transit_cost[i][j])
    
    total_cost = model.NewIntVar(0, 1000, "total_cost")
    model.Add(total_cost == sum(cost_terms))
    model.Minimize(total_cost)
    
    solver = cp_model.CpSolver()
    solver.parameters.max_time_in_seconds = 30.0
    solver.parameters.num_search_workers = 8
    
    status = solver.Solve(model)
    
    if status == cp_model.OPTIMAL or status == cp_model.FEASIBLE:
        trajectory = [solver.Value(position[k]) for k in range(path_length)]
        energy_used = sum(station_energy[i] * solver.Value(y[i]) for i in stations)
        time_used = sum(station_time[i] * solver.Value(y[i]) for i in stations)
        for i in stations:
            for j in stations:
                if transit_exists[i][j] == 1 and (i, j) in x and solver.Value(x[i, j]) == 1:
                    energy_used += transit_energy[i][j]
                    time_used += transit_time[i][j]
        cost_used = sum(transit_cost[i][j] * solver.Value(x[i, j]) 
                       for i in stations for j in stations 
                       if transit_exists[i][j] == 1 and (i, j) in x)
        print(json.dumps({
            "trajectory": trajectory,
            "total_cost": cost_used,
            "resource_consumption": [energy_used, time_used]
        }))
    else:
        print(json.dumps({
            "trajectory": [],
            "total_cost": 0,
            "resource_consumption": [0, 0]
        }))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
